英語文 · 國一下學期 · 章節筆記

頻率副詞、情態助動詞 can 與存在句

Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) show how often an action happens. They come before action verbs but after be-verbs. The modal verb "can" expresses ability or permission and is followed by a base verb. "There is" and "There are" state existence.

章節重點

頻率副詞強度與位置
always > usually > often > sometimes > seldom > never；口訣「be 動詞與助動詞之後，一般動詞之前」She is always early. / He usually walks to school. / Do you often play basketball?
情態助動詞 can 用法
can 表示能力、許可或請求，後方一律接「原形動詞」，不隨第三人稱單數加 sHe can swim very well. / Can you open the window?（否定為 can't / cannot）
There is / There are 存在句
表達「某處有某人/某物」，單數或不可數名詞用 There is，複數名詞用 There areThere is a book on the desk. / There are two parks near my home.

示範與推理

整理三句：「Lily / usually / is / early」「she / can / plays / chess」「there / two clubs / are / at school」，並說明順序。

  1. 第一句為 Lily is usually early.，be 動詞 is 在 usually 前；若換一般動詞，可說 Lily usually arrives early.。
  2. 第二句為 She can play chess.，can 已是情態助動詞，後面 play 不加 s，也不加 to。
  3. 第三句為 There are two clubs at school.，存在句中 two clubs 為複數，因此使用 are。

易錯提醒　Do not put frequency adverbs before be-verbs (say "He is always kind", not "He always is kind"). In There is/are sentences, verb agreement depends on the noun that immediately follows.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. David is a vegetarian, so he ___ eats beef or pork.
    • A．always
    • B．usually
    • C．never
    • D．sometimes
  2. Write three sentences about your weekly schedule using different frequency adverbs and the correct word order.
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　C（never）。A vegetarian does not eat meat, so the frequency is zero ("never").

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
